app_info.subtitle: Decode car diagnostic messages
app_info.description: UDS Toolbox helps automotive and embedded engineers work with UDS (ISO 14229) diagnostics. Paste raw bytes, a candump trace or a DTC and it explains them: service, sub-function, data identifiers, negative response codes and their usual causes, ISO-TP framing and timing errors, and DTC status bits. It can also build request bytes (for example a RequestDownload for a flash address) and answer reference questions about timing, sessions, security access and the reprogramming sequence. It works offline on the message text only: no account, no hardware, nothing stored. Made by the authors of the UDSLib embedded stack.

test_cases.description: Explain a negative response from an ECU.
test_cases.user_prompt: My ECU answered 7F 34 78 to a RequestDownload. What does that mean?
test_cases.expected_output: Explains it is a negative response to RequestDownload (0x34) with NRC 0x78 responsePending: not an error, the ECU needs more time, and the tester should wait using the extended P2* timeout.
Reassembles one 11-byte message on 0x7E8 (62 F1 90 57 30 4C 31 32 33 34 35), identifies the flow control frame, and decodes it as a positive ReadDataByIdentifier response for DID F190 (VIN).

test_cases.user_prompt: Build the UDS RequestDownload for address 0x08000000, 64 KiB, no compression.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns 34 00 44 08 00 00 00 00 01 00 00 with a breakdown: dataFormatIdentifier 00, addressAndLengthFormatIdentifier 44, address 0x08000000, size 0x10000.

test_cases.description: Decode a DTC and its status byte.
test_cases.user_prompt: What is DTC C0 73 00 with status 0x2F?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns U0073-00 (network domain) and lists the set status bits: testFailed, testFailedThisOperationCycle, pendingDTC, confirmedDTC, testFailedSinceLastClear.

test_cases.description: Look up the standard reprogramming flow.
test_cases.user_prompt: What is the usual UDS sequence to reflash an ECU?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the 17-step sequence (extended session, DTC off, communication control, programming session, security access, fingerprint, erase, download, transfer, exit, check, reset, restore) and notes it is a common OEM pattern, not mandated by ISO 14229.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is unrelated to vehicle or ECU diagnostics.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for general car repair advice.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: My car makes a grinding noise when braking, what should I do?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked; this is mechanical repair advice, not decoding diagnostic protocol messages.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated programming help.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write a Python function that sorts a list of dictionaries by date.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request has nothing to do with UDS, ISO-TP or DTCs.
